name: FloridaBlueE0486PriorAuthorizationRule
title: UC05 Coverage Requirement: E0486 Prior Authorization
description: Synthetic Da Vinci CRD rule fired at order-sign for a custom oral appliance coded E0486. The rule returns the UC05 test requirements for prior authorization under the medical DME benefit.
purpose: Allows the sleep EHR to discover the UC05 test payer requirements before sending the medical-to-dental referral and allows the dental system to complete the missing candidacy documentation before PAS submission.

action.title: E0486 requires prior authorization under the UC05 test plan
action.description: For the UC05 myBlue HMO test product, E0486 is a medical DME benefit requiring PA, a treating-practitioner order, qualifying sleep-test evidence, PAP intolerance or preference documentation, dental candidacy, provider identities, and a treatment plan.
